notes: Every tenant detail page now shows a 'Grant admin consent' panel above the tabs. One button per assigned bundle (Conditional Access Vault, Identity Health, License Insights). Click → opens Microsoft's hosted consent URL in a new tab, scoped to that tenant's Entra directory → sign in as an admin → accept → return to the portal and click Sync now
Without admin consent, the bundle's Entra app can't read Graph data from the target tenant and 'Sync now' silently fails. This panel gives the operator the clear path to unblock data flow
